_nota: Summary of the INIFAP 2026 Agricultural Technical Agenda, made from the text in data/inifap/extraido/tamaulipas.json following pipeline/inifap/instrucciones_resumen.md. No pesticide brands or doses.
fuente: INIFAP. Agenda Técnica Agrícola de Tamaulipas [Agricultural Technical Agenda of Tamaulipas]. INIFAP, Mexico City, 2026.

fichas.region: Warm semiarid climate, from sea level to 600 m a.s.l., with 25 to 27 °C optimal (minimum 10 °C, maximum 40 °C). Deep soils of medium to heavy texture, without waterlogging and with pH of 5.5 to 8.0; requires 500 to 600 mm of water in the cycle. Proposed for the north-central zone of the state.

siembra.texto: From April 15 to May 15, into moist soil in rows at 80 cm.

fichas.densidad: 200,000 to 250,000 plants/ha (16 to 20 plants per meter), with 1.5 to 2.0 kg/ha of seed at most. Rows at 80 cm, seed at 3 to 4 cm depth with a precision planter. Check germination and vigor before planting.
fichas.fertilizacion: For each ton of grain it requires 39-19-8 (N-P-K). Half of the N and all of the P and K before or at planting; the rest of the N at the first cultivation pass. Foliar application of boron at the start of flowering.
fichas.riego: Pre-planting irrigation (depth of 15 to 20 cm) and two supplemental irrigations of 8 to 10 cm: the first 30-35 days after plant emergence (start of flowering) and the second at 65-75 days (flowering to start of capsule formation).
plagas: Pod borer (Heliothis virescens and H. zea)
enfermedades: Charcoal rot (Macrophomina phaseolina and Fusarium oxysporum)
Brown leaf and stem spot (Alternaria sesami)
fichas.malezas: Polocote, quelite, amargosa, Bermuda grass and spike grass. Keep the crop clean for the first 40 days with two cultivation passes: the first 20-25 days after plant emergence and the second 10 days later.
fichas.cosecha: Dehiscent types: cut at ground level when the leaves yellow and the first capsules open, stack and dry for 2 to 3 weeks before threshing. Indehiscent types: mechanical harvest with the plant without foliage, dark brown color and grain at 6 to 8% moisture; plug the holes of the thresher. Expected yield: 1.2 to 1.4 t/ha under irrigation and 1.0 to 1.2 t/ha rainfed.
cuidados: Plant from April 15 to May 15.
Check seed germination and vigor to adjust the amount per hectare.
Keep the crop free of weeds for the first 40 days with two cultivation passes.
Apply worm control when 10% of plants are infested.
Avoid excess soil moisture and rotate crops to prevent rots; treat the seed with mycorrhizae and antagonistic fungi such as Trichoderma.
In direct threshing, plug all the holes in the machine through which grain could be lost.
fichas.nota: Table 2 (rainfed) was cut off in the extracted text (the table text is truncated at 3,000 characters in the middle of the fertilization section), so its values are null. The irrigated table adds up: gross income 32,400 − 13,548 = 18,852 and 32,400/13,548 = 2.39; price 27,000 $/t (contract farming).

fichas.region: Northern Tamaulipas (Matamoros, Río Bravo, Reynosa, Valle Hermoso): semidesert and warm climate, 22.7 to 24.2 °C mean and 360 to 430 mm per year, flat terrain at 120-130 m a.s.l. Soils poor in organic matter, with local salinity and drainage problems.

siembra.texto: From February 15 to March 15 (FW cycle). Plant the late varieties first, then the intermediate ones and the early ones last.

fichas.densidad: 12 kg/ha of delinted seed with a precision planter, in rows of 91 to 96 cm and 5 cm deep. Narrow row (high densities): 100,000 to 120,000 plants/ha; traditional: 90,000 to 95,000 plants/ha.
fichas.fertilizacion: 160-70-00. Nitrogen split over the first three supplemental irrigations, not applied after flowering because it delays maturity. Phosphorus according to soil analysis, granulated and all pre-planting.
fichas.riego: Total depth of 60 cm: 20 cm pre-planting and 40 cm in three supplemental irrigations at 50, 75 and 95 days after emergence, ideally with 40% moisture depletion. Critical stages: square formation, flowering, bolls and first open bolls. On clay soils irrigations are spaced further apart.
fichas.malezas: Keep the crop clean for the first 60 to 70 days after emergence, combining cultural, manual, mechanical and chemical methods.
fichas.cosecha: Defoliate when 60% of the bolls are open. Harvest and build modules with less than 10% moisture, protect the modules with tarps in high zones, remove plastics from the field and monitor temperature to take them soon to the gin. Expected yield: 3.5 t/ha.
cuidados: Remove volunteer plants before August 31 and shred stalks and plow no later than ten days after harvest to cut off overwintering pests.
Sample the whole plant periodically and apply control only according to economic thresholds, alternating products.
Maintain preventive trapping of the Binational Program (traps for weevil and pink bollworm).
Do not apply nitrogen after flowering.
Use resistant varieties and rotate with cereals or maize against Verticillium wilt.
Harvest and module the cotton with less than 10% moisture.
fichas.nota: The cost table does not state the modality; it is marked irrigated because it includes irrigations and a water fee. Price 16,000 $/t (SIAP, 2025). It adds up: 56,000 − 38,385 = 17,615 and 56,000/38,385 = 1.46.

fichas.region: Planicie Huasteca (southern Tamaulipas). Prefers soils of medium to fine texture that retain water; germinates best at 25-35 °C and grows well at 20 to 35 °C. Temperatures below 20 °C or above 35 °C at flowering increase sterility. The greatest water need is from 10 days before to a few days after flowering.

siembra.texto: SS cycle: from June 1 to July 15. Depending on the variety, from May 15 to June 30 (Milagro Filipino Tamaulipeco, Aztecas, INIFLAR RT, Pacífico FL 15, Golfo FL 16) or from June 1 to July 15 (Animas A-97, INIFLAR R).

fichas.densidad: Maximum 100 kg/ha of seed with 100% viability (equivalent to 120 kg with 85% germination) to have at least 1.5 million plants/ha and 4.5 to 5.0 million panicles/ha. Rows at 20 cm and maximum depth of 4 cm; preferably with a precision planter. If broadcast, cover the seed with a light pass of the harrow.
fichas.fertilizacion: 180-40-00. All the phosphorus pre-planting; 100 units of N at maximum tillering (30-35 days after sowing) and 80 units at the start of panicle formation (can be split into two parts, at 50 and at 60-65 days). Adding up to 110 units of potassium as potassium sulfate at 30 and 45 days is suggested.
fichas.riego: Continuous flooding: germination irrigation after planting, four supplemental irrigations of 12 to 15 cm every 12 to 15 days draining the excess, and flooding of 5 to 10 cm from when the plants are 15 to 20 cm tall (1.5 to 2.1 m of depth in total). Intermittent irrigation saves water. Stop irrigation when the grains at the base of the panicle are milky, those in the center are doughy and those at the tip are mature. Levees with a 3 to 7 cm difference in level and no more than 25 m between them.
fichas.malezas: Water grass, foxtail grass, Johnsongrass, nutsedge, quelite and bindweed. Continuous flooding helps keep weeds low; well-built levees allow planting on them and reducing weeds in those areas.
fichas.cosecha: Stop irrigations 25 to 30 days before threshing and harvest with a combine when the grain has 20 to 22% moisture; for certified seed, with 14 to 18%. Expected yield: 8 t/ha.
cuidados: Level the land well, preferably with a laser, for uniform irrigation and drainage.
Use certified seed with at least 85% germination, planted on the date for the variety.
Split the nitrogen between tillering and the start of the panicle.
Sample the brown stink bug on 400 panicles per hectare and act at 15 to 20 stink bugs per 100 panicles.
Watch for birds and rats from planting and from the start of maturity until harvest.
Stop irrigation 25 to 30 days before threshing.
fichas.nota: The varieties come from a table whose text was spread across the 'variedades', 'cosecha' and 'fecha_siembra' sections of the extracted text. The cost table (SS cycle) adds up in total cost (40,670), price (15 $/kg) and net income (120,000 − 40,670 = 79,330), but the printed 'B/C ratio' is 195, which corresponds to the return percentage (79,330/40,670 = 1.95) and not to gross income/cost (2.95); therefore relacion_bc is null.

fichas.region: Temperate-climate crop: 12 to 30 °C (optimum 21 °C, minimum 5 °C); from four leaves to before flowering it tolerates down to −8 °C. Requires 450 to 550 mm of water, especially from flowering to grain filling. Deep soils, loam to clay, pH 5.5 to 8.3, without drainage problems; tolerates moderate salinity.

siembra.texto: From October 1 to November 30, into moist soil in rows at 80 cm.

fichas.densidad: 200,000 to 250,000 plants/ha (16 to 20 plants per meter) with 1.5 to 2.0 kg/ha of seed at most. Seed at 3 to 4 cm depth with a precision planter.
fichas.fertilizacion: For each ton of grain it requires 60-25-40-12-0.1 (N-P-K-S-B). Half of the N and all of the P, K and S before or at planting; the rest of the N at the first cultivation pass. Foliar application of boron at the start of flowering.
fichas.riego: Pre-planting irrigation (15 to 20 cm) and two supplemental irrigations of 10 to 12 cm: at 40-50 days (rosette to flower bud) and at 60-70 days (flowering to start of silique formation).
fichas.malezas: Polocote, quelite, amargosa, Bermuda grass and spike grass. Keep the crop clean for the first 40 days with two cultivation passes: the first 20-25 days after plant emergence and the second 10 days later.
fichas.cosecha: Mechanical, when the plant has shed its foliage, the siliques are yellowish brown and the grain has 10 to 12% moisture. Cut just at the start of the branches with siliques and plug the holes of the thresher. Expected yield: 2.5 to 2.8 t/ha under irrigation and 1.3 to 2.0 t/ha rainfed.
cuidados: Plant from October 1 to November 30.
Keep the crop free of weeds for the first 40 days.
Control aphids at 20% of plants infested and the moth at 5 to 10 larvae per plant with damage to flowers or siliques; apply in the afternoon to protect bees.
Release lacewings from the flower bud stage for three or four weeks as biological control.
Avoid overly humid conditions to prevent powdery mildew.
Harvest with 10 to 12% grain moisture.
fichas.nota: Price from the table: 10,082 $/t (ICE canola futures, July 2025). Both tables add up (25,205 − 17,170 = 8,035; 13,106 − 11,652 = 1,454).

fichas.region: Huasteca region (south of the state), with rains from May to October. Clay-loam to clay Vertisols, of good fertility and high moisture retention; from sea level to about 300 m, flat or slightly rolling topography with slopes under 5%.

siembra.texto: Optimal period from May to September; normally planted from June to late September or early November. Some growers in Cd. Valles plant from January to March under irrigation.

fichas.densidad: 10 to 12 t/ha of seed cane of 6 to 9 months, free of borer, to achieve 120,000 to 150,000 millable stalks per hectare. Rows at 1.4 m and 35 to 40 cm deep, preferably in a double line; with drip, double pineapple-type row of 1.80 to 2.0 m between centers.
fichas.fertilizacion: Irrigated plant cane: 140-55-55 (500 kg/ha of 22-11-11-6 at the bottom of the furrow plus 300 kg of ammonium sulfate). Ratoons: 110-55-55 (500 kg/ha of 22-11-11-6 in a band two months after cutting). Rainfed: 100-138-55 at the bottom of the furrow at planting. On alkaline soils, apply zinc sulfate and repeat according to soil analysis. With drip, fertigate at every irrigation according to soil and foliar analysis.
fichas.riego: At germination, light irrigations of 8 to 14 cm. Plant cane, ratoons and second ratoons require 6 to 10 irrigations in the cycle: the first two after each fertilization and then every 3 or 4 weeks, depending on available water.
enfermedades: Smut (in variety NCo-310, increasing in southern Tamaulipas)
fichas.malezas: Grasses (Johnsongrass, Guinea grass, grama, foxtail grass, water grass, goosegrass), nutsedge and many broadleaf weeds (polocote, aceitilla, bindweed, quelite, among others). They regrow, tolerate drought and resist herbicides.
fichas.cosecha: Plant cane at 14-16 months after planting; ratoons and second ratoons at 12-14 months after the previous cutting; manual or mechanized cutting. Expected yield: 76 t/ha in plant cane, 58 t/ha in ratoon and 55 t/ha in second ratoon; potential of about 50 t/ha rainfed, 100 t/ha irrigated on black soil and up to 150 t/ha on barrote-type soils.
cuidados: Use seed cane of 6 to 9 months free of borer and cut it into pieces for good covering.
Break up compaction with a subsoiler after each cutting.
Apply zinc on alkaline soils and repeat according to soil analysis.
Irrigate after each fertilization and then every 3 or 4 weeks, depending on water availability.
Watch for spittlebug in the rainy season (March to August) and use biological control (Metarhizium fungus, Trichogramma) against pests.
Watch for smut in variety NCo-310.
fichas.nota: The crop type came as 'annual/perennial'; it is marked perennial because the cane is harvested as plant cane, ratoons and second ratoons. The fertilization recommendation was inside the 'riego' section of the extracted text. Costs (Planicie Huasteca, no modality): the sum of the printed items gives 112,900 because 'Manual labor' includes both manual harvest (8,500) and mechanical harvest (30,000); the printed total cost of 82,900 corresponds to counting only manual harvest. The printed 'B/C ratio' is 136, which is 1.36 without the decimal point (112,825/82,900 = 1.36). The table uses 120 t/ha at 940.21 $/t, more than the expected yield in the text.

fichas.region: Zones of low precipitation and low relative humidity, preferably from sea level to 800 m. Optimal temperature of 15 to 29 °C; the seedling tolerates frosts down to −7 °C. Deep, well-drained soils of medium texture (also clayey), pH 6 to 8 and moderate salinity.

siembra.texto: From November 1 to December 15, into moist soil in rows at 80 cm.

fichas.densidad: 150,000 plants/ha with 7 to 8 kg/ha of seed, at 4 to 6 cm depth, preferably with a precision planter.
fichas.fertilizacion: Run a soil analysis. For each ton of grain it requires 35-18-30 (N-P-K). All the fertilizer at planting, in a band at 10 cm depth. Foliar application of boron at the start of flowering.
fichas.riego: Pre-planting irrigation (15 to 20 cm) and two supplemental irrigations of 10 to 12 cm: the first 75 days after plant emergence and the second 35 days later. If there is only one supplemental irrigation, give it at 100-110 days.
plagas: Bugs (lygus, stink bug, leaf-footed bug and harlequin bug)
fichas.malezas: Polocote, polote, quelite, amargosa, trompillo, Bermuda grass and spike grass. Keep the crop clean for the first 40 days with two cultivation passes: the first 20-25 days after plant emergence and the second 10 days later.
fichas.cosecha: Mechanical, when the leaves and bracts of the heads are brown and the grain has less than 10% moisture. Expected yield: 2.0 to 2.5 t/ha under irrigation and 1.5 to 2.0 t/ha rainfed.
cuidados: Plant from November 1 to December 15.
Run a soil analysis and fertilize according to the expected yield.
Watch for bugs from flower bud to tender head, and for the moth at flowering and grain filling.
Prevent leaf spot from the start of the flower bud stage.
Keep the crop free of weeds for the first 40 days.
Harvest with less than 10% grain moisture.
fichas.nota: Price 9,500 $/t (FIRA, FW 2024/2025). In the irrigated table the harvest item is printed as 1,375 although its components add up to 1,300; the total cost of 17,024 corresponds to 1,300. Both tables add up in net income and B/C ratio.

fichas.region: South of the state (Altamira, González, Mante, banks of the Pánuco and Tamesí rivers) and, in a smaller area, Matamoros and Río Bravo, always with drip and fertigation. Mostly warm-humid climate, 22 to 26 °C mean, 600 to 1,600 mm of rain (80% from June to October); Vertisols, Leptosols, Regosols and Rendzinas.

siembra.texto: Sowing in trays from June 15 to September 15, with transplanting 35 to 40 days later. Establish in the field from July 15 on to avoid phytosanitary risks.

fichas.densidad: 27,000 to 32,000 plants/ha, transplanted at the sides of the drip tape (about 25 cm) with 33 to 40 cm between plants. Seedlings in 200-cell trays with sterile substrate.
fichas.fertilizacion: Gravity irrigation: 180-80-00, in a band half of the N and all of the P before planting and the rest of the N at first flowering. With drip: daily fertigation by stages (phosphonitrate, phosphoric acid, potassium nitrate and magnesium sulfate) and 200 kg/ha of MAP 11-52-00 as a base when forming the beds.
fichas.riego: Gravity: heavy irrigation of 15 to 20 cm before transplanting and then irrigations every 15 to 20 days with depths of 10 cm. The common practice in the region is drip with fertigation.
fichas.malezas: One pass between rows with a cultivator and three to four mechanical or manual cultivation passes when there are many weeds.
fichas.cosecha: Manual, when the fruits reach the size of the variety, green or fully ripe, every 15 to 20 days, with dry foliage. Respect the intervals of the products applied so as not to leave residues. Expected yield: 16 to 22 t/ha with sprinkler or gravity and 20 to 32 t/ha with drip and fertigation.
cuidados: Choose fields where maize or sorghum was grown and incorporate Trichoderma with the straw when preparing the land.
Produce the seedlings in trays and a greenhouse and transplant in the field from July 15.
Plant on raised beds or ridges and avoid excess moisture to prevent wilt and damping-off.
Use biological control (Bacillus subtilis, entomopathogenic fungi) and watch for whitefly and weevil from the first adults.
Harvest with dry foliage to avoid fruit diseases in storage and transport.
fichas.nota: The variety table is titled 'Varieties and Hybrids' but does not mark which is which; they are left as varieties because the column says 'Variety' and the source is INIFAP. Costs: the table does not state the modality (it is with drip and fertigation) or the price; the price of 22 $/kg is deduced from gross income 440,000 / 20,000 kg. It adds up: 440,000 − 250,128 = 189,872; printed ratio 1.75 (1.76 exact).

fichas.region: South and center of the state (González, Mante, Llera, Soto La Marina, Hidalgo, Tula), with drip and fertigation. Mostly warm-humid climate, 22 to 26 °C mean, 600 to 1,600 mm of rain (80% from June to October); Vertisols, Leptosols, Regosols and Rendzinas.

siembra.texto: Sowing in trays from June 15 to September 15, with transplanting 35 to 40 days later. Establish in the field from July 15 on to avoid phytosanitary risks.

variedades: Don Benito (triple purpose: industry, chipotle and fresh)
fichas.densidad: 27,000 to 32,000 plants/ha, transplanted at the sides of the drip tape (about 25 cm) with 33 to 40 cm between plants.
fichas.fertilizacion: Gravity irrigation: 200-80-00, in a band half of the N and all of the P before planting and the rest of the N at first flowering. With drip: daily fertigation by stages and 200 kg/ha of MAP 11-52-00 as a base when forming the beds.
fichas.riego: Gravity: heavy irrigation of 15 to 20 cm before transplanting and then irrigations every 15 to 20 days (one-hour sprinkler or furrow irrigation with a 10 cm depth).
fichas.malezas: One pass between rows with a cultivator and three to four mechanical or manual cultivation passes to hill up the plant and remove escaped weeds.
fichas.cosecha: Manual, every 17 to 20 days, when the fruits are 5 to 10 cm long, firm and bright green, with dry foliage. For the fresh market, corkiness must not exceed 10%. Expected yield: 25 to 35 t/ha with sprinkler or gravity and 40 to 60 t/ha with drip and fertigation.
cuidados: Choose fields where maize or sorghum was grown and incorporate Trichoderma with the straw.
Transplant in the field from July 15.
Plant on raised ridges and avoid excess moisture to prevent wilt and damping-off.
Watch for whitefly and weevil from the first adults and rely on biological control.
Harvest with dry foliage and make sure corkiness does not exceed 10%.
fichas.nota: The variety table ended up in the 'cosecha' section of the extracted text. The hybrids (H) do not carry a company in the text. Costs with drip and fertigation (the table does not state the modality); price of 10 $/kg. It adds up: 500,000 − 283,303 = 216,697. The text mistakenly says 'habanero chili' when presenting the jalapeño table.

fichas.region: South and center of the state (González, Altamira, Mante, Llera, Soto La Marina, Hidalgo, Tula), with drip and fertigation; supplies the national market in winter. Mostly warm-humid climate, 22 to 26 °C mean, 600 to 1,600 mm of rain (80% from June to October).

siembra.texto: Sowing in trays from June 15 to September 15, with transplanting 35 to 40 days later. Establish in the field from July 15 on to avoid phytosanitary risks.

fichas.densidad: 27,000 to 32,000 plants/ha, transplanted at the sides of the drip tape (about 25 cm) with 33 to 40 cm between plants.
fichas.fertilizacion: Gravity irrigation: 200-80-00, in a band half of the N and all of the P before planting and the rest of the N at first flowering. With drip: daily fertigation by stages and 200 kg/ha of MAP 11-52-00 as a base when forming the beds.
fichas.riego: Gravity: heavy irrigation of 15 to 20 cm before transplanting and then irrigations every 15 to 20 days with depths of 10 cm.
fichas.malezas: One pass between rows with a cultivator and three to four mechanical or manual cultivation passes to hill up the plant and remove escaped weeds.
fichas.cosecha: Manual, every 17 to 20 days, when the fruits reach the size of the variety, are firm and bright green, with dry foliage. Expected yield: 25 to 35 t/ha (four to seven pickings) with sprinkler or gravity and 40 to 60 t/ha with drip and fertigation.
cuidados: Choose fields where maize or sorghum was grown and incorporate Trichoderma with the straw.
Form high beds and avoid excess moisture to prevent wilt and damping-off.
Transplant in the field from July 15.
Watch for whitefly and weevil from the first adults and rely on biological control.
Harvest with dry foliage.
fichas.nota: The variety table ended up in the 'cosecha' section; Coloso, Plata, Sendero and Platino are marked as hybrids (H) and HS-44 as a variety; Centauro carries no mark and was left with the hybrids. No company is given. Costs with drip and fertigation: the table text in the extracted file is cut off after the cost per kg; the gross income (600,000) and the net income (267,197) come from the parsed values and agree with the total cost (600,000 − 332,803 = 267,197; 600,000/332,803 = 1.80). The price of 12 $/kg is deduced from 600,000/50,000.

fichas.region: Adapts from sea level to 1,900 m, with 18 to 27 °C optimal and 600 to 1,000 mm of water. Wide range of soils (except very sandy or very clayey) with good drainage and pH 6.0 to 7.5 optimal; tolerates drought and salinity. A good rotation option in the north-central zone.

siembra.texto: From March 15 to April 30, into moist soil in rows at 80 cm.

fichas.densidad: Irrigated: 50,000 to 62,500 plants/ha (4 to 5 per meter) with 4 to 5 kg/ha. Rainfed: 40,000 to 50,000 plants/ha (3 to 4 per meter) with 3.5 to 4.1 kg/ha. Seed at 4 to 5 cm, planting slowly (5 to 6 km/h).
fichas.fertilizacion: For each ton of grain it requires 41-5-29-5 (N-P-K-S). Half of the N and all of the P and S before or at planting; the rest of the N at the first cultivation pass. Boron at V8-V10 and/or at flower bud (R3).
fichas.riego: Pre-planting irrigation (15 to 20 cm) and two supplemental irrigations of 10 to 12 cm: at 30-40 days after plant emergence (R2-R3) and at the start of flowering, near 60 days (R4-R5.1).
fichas.malezas: Quelite, amargosa, trompillo, polocote, Bermuda grass and spike grass. Keep the crop clean for the first 40 days with one or two cultivation passes (the first 15-20 days after plant emergence and the second 10 days later).
fichas.cosecha: Mechanical, when the back of the head and the bracts are brown, the leaves dry and the seed has less than 12% moisture. Expected yield: 2.5 to 3.0 t/ha under irrigation and 1.5 to 2.5 t/ha rainfed.
cuidados: Plant from March 15 to April 30, slowly, for even emergence.
Control cutworm when there are one or more cut plants per meter.
Monitor the moth from the start of flowering; act at one moth per five heads and rely on lacewing releases from the flower bud stage.
From the end of flowering until harvest, scare away birds.
Rotate crops for at least two years and avoid fields that become waterlogged.
Harvest with less than 12% moisture in the seed.
fichas.nota: The agenda calls Hornet, Daytona, N4HM-354, N4HM-411, Panther and Jaguar 'varieties', without stating the company; they were put in hibridos_comerciales because they are not INIFAP or public-domain materials and the text itself speaks of hybrids. The SS cycle was deduced from the planting date (March-April). Price 11,200 $/t (NSA, May 2025). Both tables add up.

fichas.region: South of the state (Planicie Huasteca): warm-humid subtropical climate, 22 to 26 °C mean and 600 to 1,600 mm of rain (80% from June to October), at low altitude. It is also planted in the north and center of the state in FW under irrigation.

siembra.texto: South, irrigated and rainfed: SS from June 15 to August 31; FW from October 1 to January 15. North: from January 20 to February 15 (optimum February 1 to 10); after February 15 yield drops and the risk of aflatoxins increases.

fichas.densidad: South, irrigated: 62,000 to 65,000 plants/ha; rainfed: 35,000 to 50,000 plants/ha. North: 80,000 seeds/ha (18 to 22 kg/ha), to reach harvest with 70,000 to 75,000 plants/ha. Plant on the ridge of the furrow.
fichas.fertilizacion: South, irrigated: 120-60-00; all the phosphorus at planting, half of the N at the first cultivation pass and the rest at the second. Rainfed: 90-40-00 in three applications (planting, second and third fertilization). The cost table for the north uses 140-40-00.
fichas.riego: Planicie Huasteca SS: pre-planting irrigation of 15 to 20 cm, 15 to 20 days before planting; first supplemental irrigation of 10 to 15 cm at 20-25 days after planting and second supplemental irrigation at the start of grain filling, 20 to 25 days after the previous one.
fichas.malezas: Two cultivation passes: the first with plants 25 to 30 cm tall and the second at 45 to 55 cm.
fichas.cosecha: From 120 days in early materials and near 140 in intermediate-late ones, with the grain at 14-16% moisture. Take the grain to the collection center in under six hours, dry it and store it at 14% at most; aerate it when ambient humidity is below 60%. Expected yield in the south: SS 4.0 to 4.5 t/ha rainfed and 6.5 to 7.5 irrigated; intermediate cycle 4.0 to 5.0 rainfed and 7.0 to 8.0 irrigated; FW 4.0 to 5.0 rainfed and 6.0 to 7.0 irrigated. North, FW under irrigation: 7.5 t/ha.
cuidados: Respect the planting date of each region; in the north do not plant after February 15.
Control fall armyworm when more than 20% of plants are damaged.
Use certified seed of the recommended hybrids and varieties to prevent diseases.
Give two timely cultivation passes to control weeds and hill up the plants.
Harvest at 14 to 16% moisture and do not leave the grain more than six hours waiting for transport.
fichas.nota: Record with several cycles (SS, intermediate and FW) and regions, so modalidad and ciclo are null. Costs, in order: (1) Planicie Huasteca, SS and FW cycles; (2) intermediate cycle; (3) north and center, FW. All three include irrigation (for rainfed the table says to subtract the irrigation expenses). The price is not printed: 5.2 and 5 $/kg are deduced from gross income/yield. In table (2) the item 'Cultural practices' repeats 2,225 with no components; the printed total does not add it. The hybrid tables do not mark which is a variety or a hybrid; only H-443A is identified in the text as an INIFAP hybrid. The irrigated fertilization (120-60-00) was in the 'riego' section of the extracted text.

fichas.region: Northern Tamaulipas (Reynosa, Díaz Ordaz): subtropical climate, 23.3 °C mean and 504 to 750 mm of rain, from sea level to 68 m. Clay to loam soils, poor in organic matter, with salinity and poor drainage in some places. FW cycle under irrigation.

siembra.texto: From January 20 to February 15; optimum January 28 to February 5. Plant with the soil above 10 °C. After February 15 yield, grain health and popping expansion decrease.

fichas.densidad: 85,000 seeds/ha (12 to 15 kg/ha), to reach harvest with 75,000 to 80,000 plants/ha. Rows at 80 cm, 5 to 7 cm deep, planting at 5-7 km/h. A higher density does not raise yield and favors pests and fungi.
fichas.fertilizacion: 140-40-00: half of the N and all of the P before or during planting; the rest of the N before canopy closure.
fichas.riego: Pre-planting irrigation of 15 cm, 15 to 20 days before planting. Supplemental irrigations of 10 cm: at 40-45 days after plant emergence (V6-V8), 20-25 days later (heading) and 15-20 days later (milk-stage ears). Avoid drought stress at flowering and grain filling. Gated-pipe micro-gates are the most efficient method.
plagas: Cutworms (Agrotis ipsilon, Peridroma saucia, Feltia subterranea)
enfermedades: Ear rots and aflatoxins (Ustilago maydis, Fusarium, Aspergillus flavus, Penicillium)
fichas.malezas: Broadleaf: polocote, quelite, amargosa, trompillo, annual bindweed, meloncillo and chayotillo. Narrow leaf: Johnsongrass, spike grass, water grass and guiador grass. Give two cultivation passes: at 15-20 days after plant emergence and 20-30 days later.
fichas.cosecha: With the grain between 14 and 18% moisture (optimum 16-17%); below 14% it shatters and popping expansion is damaged. Take the grain to the collection center in under six hours. Expected yield: 3.7 t/ha.
cuidados: Plant between January 28 and February 5, with the soil above 10 °C.
Prepare the soil with deep tillage to improve roots and moisture and reduce the risk of aflatoxins.
Do not exceed 85,000 seeds per hectare.
Avoid water shortage at flowering and grain filling.
Control ear worms, which open the way for the fungi that produce aflatoxins.
Harvest at 16 to 17% moisture.
fichas.nota: There are no recommended varieties: the imported hybrid specified by the contracting company is used; there are no national hybrids for northern Tamaulipas. Price 6,789 $/t (June 2026). It adds up: 25,119 − 22,082 = 3,037; the printed ratio is 1.13 (1.14 exact).

fichas.region: South of the state (Huastecas region), with 600 to 1,600 mm of rain, 80% from June to October; also north and center of the state. A crop highly adaptable to warm, arid and semiarid conditions.

siembra.texto: South (intermediate cycle): from August 25 to October 25. North and center: from December 20 to March 8.

fichas.densidad: South: 200,000 to 215,000 plants/ha under irrigation and 140,000 to 150,000 rainfed, rows of 76 to 80 cm and seed at 5-7 cm. North and center: rainfed 100,000 to 150,000 plants/ha (13 to 16 seeds per meter, 5 to 6 kg/ha); irrigated 250,000 plants/ha (25 seeds per meter, 8 to 10 kg/ha), rows at 81 cm. Inoculate the seed with mycorrhiza.
fichas.fertilizacion: South, irrigated: 120-60-00; all the phosphorus at planting, half of the N at the first cultivation pass and the rest at the second. Rainfed: 90-40-00 in three applications. The cost table for the north uses 160-60-40.
fichas.riego: Intermediate cycle in the Planicie Huasteca: pre-planting irrigation of 12 to 15 cm, 15 to 20 days before planting; first supplemental irrigation of 10 to 12 cm at 35-40 days after the pre-planting irrigation and second of 10 to 12 cm 20 to 25 days later (flowering).
fichas.malezas: Two cultivation passes: the first with plants 25 to 35 cm tall and the second at 45 to 55 cm.
fichas.cosecha: From 120 days in early-intermediate materials and near 128 in intermediate-late ones, with the grain at 14-16% moisture. Dry it if it exceeds 13% and store at 12.5% in airtight containers, in a clean, dry, cool place. Expected yield: 4.0 to 5.0 t/ha rainfed and 6.0 to 7.0 t/ha under irrigation.
cuidados: Plant on the date for each region.
For sugarcane aphid, chemical control is the last option: only when it exceeds 50 aphids per plant and there are no natural enemies.
Control fall armyworm at 20% of plants damaged.
Prepare the land well, avoid excess moisture, destroy the ratoon and rotate crops to prevent diseases.
Do not leave the grain in the open and store it with less than 13% moisture.
fichas.nota: Record with two regions and cycles (south, intermediate cycle; north and center, winter), so modalidad and ciclo are null. Costs, in order: (1) Las Huastecas, intermediate cycle, under irrigation (for rainfed the irrigation expenses are subtracted); price 4 $/kg deduced from 28,000/7,000. (2) North and center: the table text is cut off in the extracted file after the total cost (20,723, which does add up with the items) and the yield; price, net income and B/C ratio are null. In the hybrid table for the south some names come together in one row (e.g. 'Ambar DKS-67') and were separated; it is not known whether they are one or two materials. The irrigated fertilization was in the 'riego' section of the extracted text.

fichas.region: Northern Tamaulipas: irregular and scarce rains, 74% from June to October, with a midsummer drought (canícula) from July 14 to August 24 and northers from November to January. Deep alluvial soils predominate, sandy loam to clay, moderately alkaline (pH 7.5 to 8.2), with poor drainage on flat land.

siembra.texto: From January 20 to March 8, into moist soil or dry with immediate irrigation.

fichas.densidad: 12 kg/ha of seed with a small-grain planter (grain drill), at 2 to 3 cm depth, in rows at 0.80 m.
fichas.fertilizacion: 140-40-20 in two parts: one month before planting half of the N and all of the P and K; one month after planting the rest of the N.
fichas.riego: Pre-planting (settling) irrigation of 10 cm before planting (or plant dry and give an initial irrigation) and two supplemental irrigations of 20 cm: at 40 days and at 65-70 days after planting.
fichas.malezas: Broadleaf and narrow-leaf weeds, before and after crop emergence; in addition, two cultivation passes.
fichas.cosecha: When the grain is at the milk-dough stage: soft and, when pressed, releases a milky white juice. Mechanical, or manual on small areas. Store the bales in a dry, clean, ventilated place, without contact with moisture. Expected yield: 23.8 t/ha of dry matter.
cuidados: Plow to 30 cm (in August for the FW cycle) and cross-harrow for a good seedbed.
Plant from January 20 to March 8.
Split the nitrogen: half one month before and half one month after planting.
Give two supplemental irrigations, at 40 and at 65-70 days.
Cut at the milk-dough stage of the grain and store the bales dry and ventilated.
fichas.nota: It is used as chopped green forage, silage or hay (bales); the yield and price in the table are for dry forage, so 'sorgo-forrajero-achicalado' is also assigned. Price 2 $/kg deduced from 47,600/23,800 (Asociación Ganadera Local de Río Bravo). It adds up: 47,600 − 19,171 = 28,429. The varieties do not carry a company in the text; RB Cañero was left as a public variety because of the RB prefix of the Campo Experimental Río Bravo and the others as commercial.

fichas.region: Southern Tamaulipas (González, Aldama, Altamira, Mante, Xicoténcatl): mostly warm-humid climate, 22 to 26 °C mean and 600 to 1,600 mm of rain (80% from June to October). Vertisols, Leptosols, Regosols and Rendzinas, pH 7.2 to 8.5, at 10 to 150 m altitude. About 447,000 ha with good rainfed potential.

siembra.texto: From June 15 to August 5. Plant Huasteca 100, Huasteca 300, Tamesí and Huasteca 600 first, and then Huasteca 200, Huasteca 400 and Huasteca 700.

fichas.densidad: Early plantings: 200,000 to 250,000 plants/ha; late: 250,000 to 300,000. Rows of 76 or 80 cm, with 42 to 67 kg/ha of seed depending on the variety. Plant on the ridge of the furrow with seed treated and inoculated with Bradyrhizobium japonicum; INIFAP mycorrhiza is advisable.
fichas.fertilizacion: Rainfed: 46 kg/ha of phosphorus. Irrigated: 23 to 30 kg/ha of nitrogen and 60 kg/ha of phosphorus. Supplement with micronutrients (molybdenum, cobalt, boron, iron, manganese and zinc).
fichas.riego: Furrow: pre-planting irrigation of 10 to 12 cm, 15 to 20 days before planting; first supplemental irrigation at 25-30 days after emergence and second at the end of flowering or start of grain filling, of 10 to 12 cm. With drip, irrigate when the tensiometer reads 30 to 40 cb (one tensiometer every 5 to 10 ha).
fichas.malezas: Cultivation pass at 20 days after emergence, hand weeding if needed and a second cultivation pass 8 to 10 days later. In conservation agriculture, control weeds before planting.
fichas.cosecha: From November 1 to December 10, with the plants fully defoliated and the grain at 14-16% moisture, with a combine harvester. In conservation agriculture use a combine with a residue chopper and spreader. Expected yield: 2,500 kg/ha rainfed and 3,000 to 4,000 kg/ha under irrigation.
cuidados: Use INIFAP varieties and respect the planting order according to their photoperiod sensitivity.
Treat and inoculate the seed with Bradyrhizobium before planting.
Against defoliating larvae, prefer integrated management with biological control (AgNPV virus) and act according to the threshold of larvae per meter and percentage of defoliation.
For Asian rust, apply preventively under low temperature and high humidity, and immediately on seeing the first symptoms.
Lay out rows perpendicular to the slope to avoid erosion.
Harvest at 14 to 16% moisture.
fichas.nota: The weed text was inside the 'enfermedades' section of the extracted text. Costs for southern Tamaulipas: the table does not state the modality; it is marked rainfed because it has no irrigation expenses and uses the rainfed yield. The gross income appears as '20,00' (20,000); price 8 $/kg deduced. It adds up: 20,000 − 13,197 = 6,803; printed ratio 1.51 (1.52 exact).

fichas.region: South of the state: 22 to 26 °C mean, maximums of 32 to 50 °C in May-June and minimums of 3 to 10 °C in December-January; 600 to 1,600 mm of rain (80% from June to October). Vertisols, Leptosols, Regosols and Rendzinas. Almost all of it is saladette tomato.

siembra.texto: Determinate-habit hybrids in the open field: from July 1 to September 20. Indeterminate materials: from August 1 to September 30.

fichas.densidad: 16,000 to 18,000 plants/ha, transplanted at the center of beds of 1.84 to 2.0 m, at 40 cm between plants. Seedlings in 200-cell trays with sterile substrate.
fichas.fertilizacion: Gravity irrigation: 140-80-00, in a band half of the N and all of the P before transplanting and the rest of the N at the start of flowering. On zinc-poor soils, apply zinc sulfate and decide on the second application with soil analysis. With drip, fertigation by stages.
fichas.riego: Gravity: transplant irrigation of 20 cm, first supplemental irrigation of 10 cm at 8-10 days and then light irrigations (7 to 10 cm) every 15 to 20 days depending on rainfall.
fichas.malezas: Cultivation passes and hoeing as often as needed.
fichas.cosecha: Local market: red fruit; national: breaker-stage fruits; export: mature green or three-quarter ripe. Grade the product according to the market. Expected yield: 20 to 35 t/ha with sprinkler or gravity and 40 to 60 t/ha with drip and fertigation.
cuidados: Choose fields where maize or sorghum was grown and incorporate Trichoderma with the straw.
Produce the seedlings in trays and a greenhouse to ensure establishment.
Plant determinate materials from July 1 to September 20 and indeterminate ones from August 1 to September 30.
Against late blight, alternate modes of action and do not exceed four applications per season.
Harvest at the maturity stage each market requires and take care of the health and presentation of the fruit.
fichas.nota: The materials in the variety and hybrid table do not carry a company or a variety or hybrid mark; the text speaks of determinate-habit hybrids, so they are listed as commercial. Costs with drip and fertigation (the table does not state the modality); price 12 $/kg deduced from 480,000/40,000. It adds up: 480,000 − 203,483 = 276,517.

fichas.region: Northern Tamaulipas (Gustavo Díaz Ordaz, Matamoros, Miguel Alemán, Reynosa, Río Bravo, Valle Hermoso): arid and semiarid environment, 23.5 °C mean and 450 to 720 mm of rain, from 0 to 50 m. Rendzinas of alluvial origin, 77% clay texture.

siembra.texto: From November 1 to December 20, with a grain drill in rows at 18 cm and seed at 5 cm.

fichas.fertilizacion: 130 kg/ha of nitrogen and 40 kg/ha of phosphorus before or at planting.
fichas.riego: Three irrigations: pre-planting of 15 cm, 15 to 25 days before planting; supplemental irrigations of 10 cm at 40 days after planting and 35 days after the first.
fichas.malezas: Broadleaf weeds, to be controlled between the tillering and stem elongation stages. No cultivation passes are made.
fichas.cosecha: At 110-120 days after emergence, with the plant completely dry and the grain near 14% moisture. Store in a cool, dry place under cover, and sell soon. Expected yield: 4.0 t/ha under irrigation and 2.0 t/ha rainfed.
cuidados: Plant from November 1 to December 20 with certified seed.
Use the suggested varieties, tolerant to leaf rust.
Watch for aphids in the early stages; the threshold is more than 100 aphids per 30 cm of row.
Control broadleaf weeds between tillering and stem elongation.
Harvest with the grain near 14% moisture and store in a cool, dry place.
fichas.nota: Price 4,227 $/t (CME futures, July 2025). For rainfed, the net income is printed as 1,941 without a sign, but it is a loss: 8,454 − 10,395 = −1,941, which agrees with the return percentage of −19% and the B/C ratio of 0.81; it is recorded as −1,941.
